indicator_name: Goods exports by region and HS section, tonnes, monthly
description: Экспорт товаров по регионам и разделам ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС, тонн, помесячно
methodology: 21 regions plus national. TOTAL is the published row (national or the region's heading row); a section is the sum of its 6-digit lines in the region, kept only when the region's lines reproduce its heading row. Region = where the exporter is registered, not where the good is produced or consumed. OTHER = code 999999. Raw file: bns_exports_2026-09-16.xlsx.
